title: Every Breaking Wave at OPUNAKE beach.
what_it_shows: Wordless scenic clip of waves breaking along Opunake Beach, South Taranaki, on what looks like a clean/glassy day. Does not name or visibly show the artificial reef structure; general confirmation this is the same beach the reef sits on.

frames.caption: Wet sand foreshore at Opunake Beach with a faint rainbow and small lines of whitewater breaking in the distance; viewed and honestly captioned, no reef structure visible (frame kept as general site context, not reef evidence).

title: Opunake Classic 2015
what_it_shows: Footage from the 2015 "Opunake Classic" surf contest at Opunake Beach — a competitor riding a wave. Uploaded by an "Opunake Surf" channel, confirming local surf-community activity at this exact beach; does not identify or discuss the artificial reef.

frames.caption: A surfer in a red top dropping in on a breaking wave during the 2015 Opunake Classic contest; viewed and honestly captioned, no reef structure visible.

title: Opunake Beach - Taranaki NZ
